svg.title: Figure 2.20 Instrumentation Amplifier Configurations and Analysis
svg.desc: Three subfigures showing the instrumentation amplifier: (a) Initial approach with separate grounded resistors R1 at node X; (b) Improved configuration with node X disconnected from ground and the two resistors combined into a single 2R1; (c) Differential signal analysis of the circuit with virtual grounds and node voltages vO1, vO2, and differential output vO.
